**Strategies to Improve Egg Quality and Number of Eggs**

Egg quality and egg number are crucial factors for successful conception, whether natural or through IVF. Egg number mainly depends on age and ovarian reserve, while egg quality reflects the genetic and metabolic health of the egg. Although new eggs cannot be created, the quality of existing eggs can be improved by optimizing the body’s internal environment.

A healthy lifestyle forms the foundation of good egg health. A balanced diet rich in proteins, antioxidants, fruits, vegetables, nuts, and healthy fats helps reduce oxidative stress on eggs. Maintaining an ideal body weight, avoiding smoking, alcohol, and excess caffeine, and ensuring adequate sleep are equally important. Stress reduction through yoga, meditation, or regular physical activity supports hormonal balance.

Medical optimization also plays a key role. Treating thyroid disorders, insulin resistance, and hormonal imbalances improves ovulation and ovarian response. Supplements such as CoQ10, myo-inositol, vitamin D, and omega-3 fatty acids may enhance egg quality when taken under medical supervision.

In IVF, individualized stimulation protocols, correct dosing, and precise timing can improve the number of mature eggs retrieved. Ultimately, improving egg quality and number is a gradual process, and early, personalized fertility care offers the best chance of success.

What is SSG? 🌸

SSG (Saline Sonohysterography) is a special ultrasound test where saline is gently used to clearly see the inside of the uterus.

SSG helps detect:
✅ Uterine polyps
✅ Fibroids
✅ Adhesions or scars
✅ Causes of infertility
✅ Causes of recurrent pregnancy loss

A clear and healthy uterine cavity can improve the chances of implantation and pregnancy. Early diagnosis helps your fertility specialist plan the right treatment at the right time. 💛

At Sunrise Fertility & IVF Centre, we provide accurate fertility evaluation and personalized care for every couple’s parenthood journey.

When Should You Get an HSG Test? 🌸

An HSG (Hysterosalpingography) is a simple X-ray test that checks whether your fallopian tubes are open and evaluates the shape of your uterus. It is an important investigation for couples facing difficulty conceiving.

Your doctor may recommend an HSG if:
✅ You have been trying to conceive for 1 year without success (or 6 months if you are over 35)
✅ Pregnancy is not happening despite regular ovulation
✅ You are planning IUI treatment
✅ There is a suspicion of blocked fallopian tubes or unexplained infertility

Blocked fallopian tubes can prevent the egg and sperm from meeting, making natural conception difficult. Identifying the cause early helps your fertility specialist choose the most appropriate treatment.

💛 Early diagnosis leads to better fertility planning and improved chances of pregnancy.

What is Follicular Study? 🌸

Follicular study is a series of ultrasound scans done to track egg growth and identify the right time of ovulation.

It helps in:
✅ Knowing the exact ovulation day
✅ Tracking follicle/egg growth
✅ Timing intercourse or IUI correctly
✅ Improving chances of pregnancy

Right timing can make all the difference when you are trying to conceive. Follicular study helps identify your most fertile days and supports better fertility planning.

At Sunrise Fertility & IVF Centre, we guide couples with accurate monitoring and personalized fertility care. 💛

What is Unexplained Infertility? 🤔🌸

Unexplained infertility means all common fertility reports may look normal, but pregnancy is still not happening.

Common tests may show normal:
✅ Ovulation
✅ Semen analysis
✅ Fallopian tubes
✅ Hormone levels

But sometimes, the cause may be hidden — like egg quality, sperm function, fertilization issues, implantation problems, or mild endometriosis.

The good news is: treatment options are available. 💛
With expert evaluation, personalized planning, and timely treatment, many couples can still achieve pregnancy.

Don’t lose hope. Consult a fertility specialist and take the next step toward parenthood. ✨

owner_posts.post_text: Most women who freeze eggs use them within a few years rather than at the full ten-year legal limit, with timing driven by career, health, or relationship readiness rather than a biological urgency to retrieve sooner. Annual storage fees accumulate over years, so understanding the realistic window for use helps patients plan practically alongside the medical decision. Saraogi Hospital & IRIS IVF Centre gives honest, individualised guidance on storage timelines and age considerations for Egg Freezing in Mumbai.

This National Doctor's Day, Team Saraogi Hospital & IRIS IVF Centre wishes every doctor a heartfelt Happy Doctor's Day! As a trusted IVF Centre in Mumbai, we celebrate every hope turned into happiness and every dream turned into a new beginning. You care, you heal, you create miracles.

A full diagnostic workup following twelve months of failed conception after miscarriage typically begins with AMH testing, a thyroid panel, pelvic ultrasound, and semen analysis covering both partners rather than assuming the cause lies with one. Accurate ovulation tracking through follicular monitoring or LH testing also informs the clinical picture. Dr. Mohit Saraogi, an IVF doctor in Mumbai, structures this evaluation as the standard first step for couples in this situation.

Lifestyle factors including smoking, excess alcohol, chronic stress, and inadequate sleep affect fertility in both men and women, compounding the impact of any underlying medical cause already present. None of these factors alone typically explains infertility, but their combined effect is measurable. As an infertility specialist in Mumbai, Dr. Mohit Saraogi addresses modifiable lifestyle factors alongside structured diagnostic testing during every fertility consultation.

Ovulation monitoring through blood tests and ultrasound scans ensures IUI is timed accurately to the fertile window, which directly affects the likelihood of successful fertilisation in a given cycle. This monitoring is conducted throughout both natural and medicated IUI protocols. Dr. Mohit Saraogi, providing IUI Treatment in Mumbai, builds this monitoring into every treatment cycle, adjusting timing based on each patient's individual ovulatory response rather than a fixed calendar schedule.

IVF healthcare is a coordinated clinical process — ovarian stimulation, egg retrieval under ultrasound guidance, laboratory fertilisation through IVF or ICSI, embryo culture to blastocyst stage, and timed uterine transfer — supported throughout by hormonal monitoring, diagnostic review, and personalised protocol adjustments. Saraogi Hospital & IRIS IVF Centre, an IVF doctor in Mumbai, builds each treatment plan around individual diagnostic findings rather than a generalised fertility protocol.

Research across millions of IVF births shows no significant difference in the cognitive, physical, or psychological development of children conceived through IVF compared to those conceived naturally. Concerns about IVF babies' health persist largely because they are not consistently addressed at the consultation stage. Saraogi Hospital & IRIS IVF Centre, where an IVF doctor in Mumbai, integrates clear, evidence-based health outcome discussions into every patient consultation before any cycle is recommended or initiated.

AMH reflects the quantity of remaining follicles in the ovaries, but its clinical significance depends entirely on the patient's age — a reading of 1.2 ng/mL means something very different at 29 than at 41. Normal reference ranges shift with age: 2.5–5.0 ng/mL at 25–30 years, narrowing to 0.5–2.5 ng/mL between 36 and 40. As an IVF specialist in Mumbai, Saraogi Hospital & IRIS IVF Centre interprets AMH alongside antral follicle count and prior stimulation response before finalising any fertility treatment approach.

IUI involves processing a semen sample in the laboratory to concentrate motile sperm, then placing them directly into the uterus via a thin catheter timed to coincide with ovulation — eliminating the cervical barrier that filtered sperm must otherwise navigate in natural conception. The procedure takes under 10 minutes and requires no anaesthesia. Saraogi Hospital & IRIS IVF Centre offers IUI Treatment in Mumbai with ovulation monitoring and a full diagnostic workup before any protocol is recommended.

PGT-A screens IVF embryos for chromosomal abnormalities before transfer — identifying which embryos have the correct chromosome count and reducing the risk of failed implantation and miscarriage in high-risk groups. It is most clinically relevant for women over 37, those with recurrent miscarriage, and patients with repeated implantation failure despite good-quality embryos. As an IVF specialist in Mumbai, Saraogi Hospital recommends PGT-A based on case history and failure pattern, not as a routine add-on.

featured_reviews.review_text:
While trying to conceive, we had been through all the regular routes, homeopathy, ayurveda, HRT, IUI. Something about IVF made us feel that maybe it wasn’t the best way ahead for us. But the truth is, we probably needed to get to it sooner to save ourselves the prolonged disappointment and get closure either-way.

I believe we met Dr. Anand at the right time in our lives, thanks to friends of ours who had just delivered their babies under his care. We were immediately put at ease when we met him. Unlike some of the biggest doctors we met, who put me through some very unnecessary and discouraging tests, Dr.Anand asked us to put all that in the back burner & start afresh with complete faith. He was always very realistic and practical about the options and odds he presented us with. No false promises, no pessimism either.

He caught something in one of my reports that no one else had so far and with a small procedure we took care of it and marched towards our transfer. We were blessed to have conceived in our first attempt. It was such a surreal and special moment.

But the journey didn’t get any easier. I had minor bleeding incidents in the first trimester & Dr. Anand was always accessible and responsive in administering the best protocol to safeguard the pregnancy. In the 22nd week, after everything seemed under control, I went to visit my family in Chennai. During that time, some odd symptoms pushed me to go for a Scan where we found out that I was almost fully dilated and had to be taken in for an emergency cerclage & pessary placement. All these words just flew over my head. But something kept me very calm and strong, I knew I had to keep it together for the baby and not make things worse by panicking. Dr. Anand was very involved right from talking to the radiologist to finding out about the doctor who would be performing the procedure. The recovery period was very tense & we always had him in our corner any time we wanted to understand the situation better.

I was on modified bed rest for the remainder of the pregnancy during which, I only practiced gratitude for having come this far and having caught things at the right time. Thanks to the best medical care, family and an extraordinary husband who dint let me worry about anything, I completed 37 weeks and delivered my baby through an elective C-sec. It will be one of my most humbling achievements as the odds of this happening were bleak and each passing day post the cerclage was a bonus. I was overcome with resilience along with complete surrender. It’s a special state of mind to lock into and I wish to carry this strength forward.

We wholeheartedly thank Dr. Anand for giving us the beautiful gift that is our daughter. His passion shone in the way he tailor made our protocol for us, screened every report with a fine tooth comb while projecting a spirit that kept things light & in perspective. We love you. This was not possible without you, your care and your expertise.

Ekta & Ninad

Our experience with Dr. Anand has been incredible. I am 41 and have just been blessed with a baby girl delivered by Dr. Anand through IVF procedure.

At advanced maternal age, after 2 miscarriages, existing adenomyosis/endometriosis and with potentially poor quality of eggs due to medical history, I was certain of not just relying on trial and error through natural conception. We knew IVF was the way forward for us.

We tried IVF procedure at other clinics and met many doctors before making this critical decision of trusting Dr. Anand with our journey.

IVF procedure requires a lot of time, patience and commitment from both doctor and patient - I underwent 3 IVF cycles to finally achieve 4 usable embryos at Dr. Anand’s clinic. I also underwent medically induced menopause and hysteroscopy to reduce the impact of pre-existing adenomyosis/endometriosis before we went ahead with embryo transfer. Successful conception happened in the 2nd cycle of embryo transfer. The IVF medications continued till end of 4th month to support the pregnancy.

It was physically, emotionally, mentally and financially demanding journey. We completely trusted Dr. Anand's expertise and he has been our guide through this journey.

What was great during this journey ?
We have been with Benzer and Dr. Anand since 2023 and he was always available at all times and promptly and patiently answered all our queries. He would spend time with us explaining every step of journey and gently guiding us through the steps - right from the medications to the injections to the final delivery,  he was with us.
